aiChat.title: AI Assistant
aiChat.emptyDescription: Describe what you want to create — I'll pick a template, theme, arrange your photos, and write the text automatically.
aiChat.assistantSuccess: Done! I've set up your project. Feel free to adjust anything in the editor.
aiChat.assistantError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
aiChat.assistantRateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
aiChat.assistantNeedsInfo: Sure! To get started, tell me a bit more: What's the occasion (wedding, birthday, trip…)? What mood or style are you going for? You can also attach some photos.
aiChat.assistantFewPhotos: Just a heads up: photobooks look their best with 5+ photos. I'll do my best with what you've attached!
aiChat.greetingPhotobook: Hey! I'm your AI assistant. I can set up your entire photobook — pick a template, choose a theme, arrange your photos, and write captions. Tell me about your occasion — what are we celebrating?
aiChat.greetingPortfolio: Hey! I'm your AI assistant. I can build your portfolio — pick a template, choose a style, place your work, and write your bio. Tell me about yourself and what you do!
